name: ink Teen Advisory Group
what_you_do: Help make ink, the library's yearly magazine of teen writing and art. Pick which pieces get in, work on design and layout, plan the launch party and join workshops with writers and artists.
who_can_apply: Anyone 13 to 18 years old who lives or goes to school in Vancouver.
duration: February to December. Meetings every other Thursday during the school year (online or at Central Library), plus two-day summer workshops with mentors.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The ink page links an application form. Separately, writing and art for ink volume 10 can be sent in until April 23, 2027.
how_to_apply: Use the 'Click here to apply to ink TAG' form on the ink page. Questions: teens@vpl.ca or 604.331.3690.
notes: You can also send your own writing or art to ink (up to two pieces a year) without joining the group. The page says art or writing made with AI will not be published.
